snippet.title: SlapGains — Official Trailer | Demo Coming Soon
snippet.description:
Demo coming soon. Wishlist SlapGains on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5053840/SlapGains/

Swinging is easy. Landing it isn't.

SlapGains is a power-slap duel against the clock. Two figures, one podium, arm's length apart. First one to wobble loses.

There is no block button. You read the wind-up, commit to blocking or rolling with it, and live with the choice.

The body is the stat sheet.

There are no skill points to spend. There are machines.

Train power and your upper arms thicken and your shoulders widen. Train legs and you stand your ground longer. You read your progress off the figure, not off a number.

Five leagues, a ranking that means something.

Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond. Twenty rungs in all.

Your points run through a dedicated server and out to the Steam leaderboard from there. Everyone above you got there by playing.

And the trophy wall in your gym fills up with what you actually earned.

All one room.

No loading screen between training and fighting. The gym, the hallway and the arena are a single place you walk through.

Four training machines, each with its own rhythm minigame
Duels with wind-ups, feints, blocks, rolls and counters
Slow-motion replay when a slap really lands
Visible muscle growth, per body region
Five leagues, twenty rungs, server-verified leaderboards
Eight languages
Full controller support
